description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy- Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017 Order Under Section 22 (1) -Regulations
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a regulatory order under the Foreign Exchange Act, establishing new financial regulations and limits on foreign currency transactions, investments, and remittances. It creates legal/regulatory frameworks for foreign exchange controls without focusing on government personnel changes or organizational structure.
